title: Preserved pandas input needs explicit finite-value validation in selectors
answers: Why does SelectKBest accept infinity with pandas output?
How should feature selectors validate DataFrames with set_output(transform="pandas")?
Does VarianceThreshold allow infinity as well as NaN during transform?
body:
Symptom: Feature selectors accept infinity or NaN during transform with pandas output even when the selector disallows NaN.
Root cause: sklearn/feature_selection/_base.py:SelectorMixin.transform uses skip_check_array=preserve_X, bypassing the array-level finite-value check when preserving the DataFrame.
Fix pattern: When preserving input bypasses array validation, explicitly call assert_all_finite(X, input_name="X") before _transform for selectors whose input_tags.allow_nan is false.
Constraints: The guard rejects both infinity and NaN only when allow_nan is false. When true, both pass through, matching the NumPy path; sklearn/feature_selection/tests/test_variance_threshold.py:test_transform_dataframe_allow_nan explicitly tests this exception.
applies: Feature selectors using SelectorMixin.transform with preserved pandas input and pandas output.
